title: Add auditor and warden roles with protected-file landing hold
summary: Implement the 2026-10-16 BRIEF addendum for the owner: an auditor role that judges real outcomes against BRIEF.md and owner goals, and a warden role that holds any landing touching protected files or weakening a check. Modeled on how the audience role was added (role definition, core module, CLI command, tests, design doc).

defaults_applied.how: All new code and tests in Rust.
Unit and CLI tests for both roles; cargo test and clippy pass.
Warden hold enforced in the landing gate by code, not prose.
Short design doc with alternatives alongside the roles.
Criteria check a landing being held, not just that a role exists.
One change covering both roles, reusing the role/ladder machinery.
Docs and CHANGELOG entry written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: Athena may grade its own work inside itself because the yardstick is protected; audience is the owner/maintainer reading BRIEF.md and judging the result.
The audience role (roles.rs, core/audience.rs, cli audience command, docs/design/audience-role.md) is the template for new roles.

Protected set = BRIEF.md, the auditor's and warden's own prompts and checks, grader prompts and thresholds (verifier/reader prompts, scoring thresholds), permissions, budgets, kill switch; enforcement lives in the landing gate (athena-gate).

Jobs cannot change these; only the owner can, so a landing touching them is held (not landed) with a recorded reason, and weakening a check is detected where mechanically decidable (e.g. removed/loosened thresholds).
Auditor is read-only and judges against BRIEF.md/owner goals rather than a job's own criteria, citing real outcomes (not just records).
Tests use the fake agent; no live model calls.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`: new tests pass showing a landing that modifies BRIEF.md, an auditor/warden prompt, a grader prompt or threshold, or a permission/budget/kill-switch setting is held by the warden with a recorded reason, while an ordinary landing still lands.
Run `cargo test`: a test shows a landing that removes or loosens a check (e.g. deletes a test or lowers a threshold in a protected file) is held.

crates/athena-data/src/roles.rs defines `auditor` and `warden` RoleDefinitions (valid, short fixed prompts) with tests; the auditor prompt says to judge against BRIEF.md and owner goals, not the job's criteria, and to look at real outcomes.

Run `cargo test`: an auditor run through the fake agent records a verdict citing evidence of a real outcome, and a test shows a job cannot alter the auditor's or warden's prompts or checks (such a change is held).
A design doc and CHANGELOG entry explain the two roles, the protected list, alternatives considered, and that only the owner changes these rules; a reader can find the protected list in one place.

out_of_scope: Editing BRIEF.md or any records/ files
Changing athena.toml or defaults.toml budgets, permissions, or kill-switch values
Changing existing grader (verifier/reader) prompts or thresholds
Making the auditor or warden run on live models in CI
Other roles or the parallel initiatives work
departures: Request spans two roles plus a gate-level hold across several crates, so cost, time and pass risk exceed the reference.
